definitions.explanation: The side of something facing north, or the area to the north of a reference point. Often used for the side of a building, road, or region.

examples.english: There is an exit on the north side of the station.

examples.japanese: {北側|きたがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{当|あ}たらない→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: Rooms on the north side don't get much sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北側|きたがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A large parking lot extends on the north side of the building.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧ (north) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Used for any north-facing side or location to the north. Frequently appears in real estate and direction-giving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北側|きたがわ}: north side of the station
- {北側|きたがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: north-facing window
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北側|きたがわ}: north side of the road
- {北側|きたがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧: to face north

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{南側|みなみがわ}→南側：27543_minamigawa⟧: south side
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- ⟦{西側|にしがわ}→西側：27563_nishigawa⟧: west side
- ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧: north (the direction itself)
